articles.title: Zelensky on his trip to Moscow: It's dangerous there now—there are too many Ukrainian drones
articles.summary: President Zelensky joked in response to U.S. President Trump's question about traveling to Moscow for talks, stating there were too many Ukrainian drones there.

articles.title: If Ukraine had licenses to produce Patriot systems, it could protect both itself partners, Zelensky says
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that if Ukraine were granted U.S. licenses to produce Patriot systems, domestic production would be sufficient to protect Ukraine and help partners in need.

articles.title: Zelensky discusses needs for urgent air defense missiles delivery with Rutte
articles.summary: President Zelensky met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte during the NATO summit to discuss urgent delivery of air defense missiles and contributions to the PURL initiative.

articles.title: Zelensky reiterates call for Ukraine's NATO membership: It will make us all stronger
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine's unique experience in modern warfare and defense capabilities would significantly strengthen NATO, and argued Ukraine should become a member of the Alliance.
